title: Calendar date (research candidate)
reason:
Depth: focused. Confidence high in research distinction, not accepted mapping. Timestamp at midnight can still be instant; event timezone/context required. Public dataset coverage/rights require separate discovery. Possible current core comparison: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/date?ref=982916d73f0a35ff2558b0062f58aa3ac4f24d97; unresolved scope/representation match.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core date; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. Separate calendar date, local wall time, UTC instant, duration, observation period and validity bounds. Timezone, calendar and source event role are prerequisites for conversion. Employees 9999-01-01 is an open-ended validity sentinel; shift time lacks a date. A midnight string alone does not establish a UTC instant. Date-only native/source semantics can reuse core date; timestamp truncation needs an explicit query transformation.
practical_value: Timestamp at midnight can still be instant; event timezone/context required.
showcase_value: Contextual graph/map/time-series opportunity; practical compatibility remains prerequisite.
